data-portability.title: Data export
data-portability.description: Create the existing archive for stored CRM records that carry a source type, source ID, and source payload.
data-portability.backup-unavailable: Complete firm backup unavailable — needs review
data-portability.not-a-backup-title: This is not a complete firm backup.
data-portability.not-a-backup-description: This doorway copies every stored CRM record with those three source fields, regardless of import provider. It does not select only Wealthbox records.
data-portability.includes-records: For each eligible stored CRM record: its source type, source ID, copied source payload, and target record ID when one is stored.
data-portability.includes-manifest: A manifest with the total record count and counts by source record type.
data-portability.includes-fidelity: The fidelity rows saved in the migration report. Success is shown only when every archived source type has a matching, reconciled row.
data-portability.excludes: The contract omits stored records missing any of the three source fields. It does not copy workspace documents or email as files, but a CRM record describing either is included when it has all three fields.
data-portability.decrypted-warning: The JSON file is decrypted. Store it only in a place your firm approves.
data-portability.workspace-required: Open a workspace before creating an archive.
data-portability.needs-review-error: The export needs review because its receipt, file checksum, manifest counts, or fidelity coverage could not be completely verified.
data-portability.export-failed: The archive could not be created.
